projects.title: DinoApply
projects.tagline: Essay review built as an engineered pipeline, not a single model call.
projects.problem: Feedback on an application essay is only useful when it is specific to the draft in front of it. One generation pass returns notes that cite nothing, repeat each other, and give no signal about which of them to trust.
projects.built: The review path runs as six separate stages instead of a single generation call, so each step can be reasoned about, measured, and repaired on its own.
projects.result: Annotations tied to the student's own words, calibrated and deduplicated before they reach the student.

pipeline.detail: The draft is segmented into a structural map before any feedback is generated.
Feedback is generated as structured records rather than free prose.
Every annotation is anchored to spans in the source text.
Severity and confidence are calibrated before anything reaches the student.
Overlapping notes are collapsed by meaning rather than by string match.

crosscutting.label: Across every stage
crosscutting.detail: Malformed or partial model output is repaired rather than dropped, at whichever stage it occurs.
